# Bounded gate implementation

Own only python/pokemon_switch_soak/gates.py. Standard library only. Implement
validate(report, plan, rows), returning None or raising ValueError for all invalid
inputs (including missing fields, wrong types, booleans in numeric fields and NaN).
The coordinator owns the runner/checkpoints/sealer and tests. You are not alone;
do not edit other files or recursively delegate.

Frozen plan is switch-soak-1. Reject any different version, target (7200), warmup
(8), telemetry (60), checkpoint (600), host gap (30), seed (101), max updates
(10000000), minimum cycles (1000) or RSS cap (2147483648). Smoke is exactly
20/4/8 seconds. All frozen numeric plan constants require non-boolean int types,
not equal floats. Scope fields are also frozen exactly as the supplied plan;
reject any scope relaxation even if report and altered plan agree. Read report mode qualification or smoke; passed required. Only
qualification has two_hour_qualification true. Both preserve every scope field
from the plan (full_g2/g3/g4, public_ladder_strength, strength_evaluation,
final_evaluation_used, public_server_used, prime_used). Require
final_reservation_unchanged true; positive real compile control first events and
zero same-shape events.

Report.soak has elapsed_seconds, process_cpu_seconds, cycle_seconds,
maximum_host_gap_seconds, unexpected_compilations, warmup_compilation_count,
minimum_logp, maximum_logp, peak_process_rss_bytes, cycles, games, decisions,
terminal, truncated, actions (four integer counts), initial_counters and
final_counters (updates, optimizer_step, next_game), telemetry_rows, replays,
decisions_per_elapsed_second. All numerical fields must be finite and appropriately
typed; counts are nonnegative integers (no bool). Elapsed target..target+30;
positive CPU and cycle seconds; cycle_seconds<=elapsed_seconds; max gap0..30;
unexpected0, warmup compile>0, peak RSS>0<=cap. Behavior log probabilities satisfy
-48*ln(2)-1e-5 <= minimum_logp <= maximum_logp <=1e-6.

Qualification cycles>=1000 (smoke>=1); games=32*cycles;
64*cycles<=decisions<=896*cycles; terminal+truncated=games;
sum(actions)=decisions. Counter triples strictly link optimizer_step=2*updates,
next_game=32*updates, 0<=updates<=maxupdates. Initial updates8;
final updates=8+cycles. Throughput exactly decisions/elapsed.
Replays = start+final+periodic:13 qualification,4 smoke (8 and16seconds).

Rows list must equal telemetry_rows. Count target//interval-1 or target//interval
(nonempty), each row scheduled_seconds=i*interval for 1-based i;
scheduled<=elapsed<=scheduled+30 and elapsed<=summary elapsed. Last row elapsed
>=target-interval. Row fields cycles/games/decisions/terminal/truncated/actions
obey the same accounting, counters equal initial counters plus row cycles and
are no later than final. Every row numerical field must be finite. Row elapsed,
cycles and decisions strictly increase; all aggregate count fields (including
each action) are nondecreasing and <= summary. Rows have maximum_host_gap_seconds,
unexpected_compilations, minimum_logp, maximum_logp, memory.peak_process_rss_bytes
with the same bounds; peak <=summary peak. The runner may include extra fields.
If the last row has the same cycle count as the summary, all its aggregate counts
must be equal. Missing/malformed inputs raise ValueError, never accidentally pass.

This checks internal consistency only. Sealer separately checks source/runtime,
report checksum, telemetry hashes, complete checkpoint roster and fresh replay.
import copy
import importlib.util
import json
from pathlib import Path
import unittest

ROOT=Path(__file__).resolve().parents[2]
spec=importlib.util.spec_from_file_location('gates',ROOT/'python/pokemon_switch_soak/gates.py')
gates=importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec);spec.loader.exec_module(gates)
PLAN=json.loads((ROOT/'contracts/switch-soak-v1/plan.json').read_text())


def fixture(smoke=False):
    seconds,interval=(20,4) if smoke else (7200,60)
    def counts(n):return dict(cycles=n,games=32*n,decisions=400*n,terminal=10*n,truncated=22*n,actions=[100*n]*4)
    def counters(n):return dict(updates=8+n,optimizer_step=2*(8+n),next_game=32*(8+n))
    s=dict(**counts(seconds),elapsed_seconds=float(seconds),process_cpu_seconds=9000.,cycle_seconds=seconds*.8,
        maximum_host_gap_seconds=.1,unexpected_compilations=0,warmup_compilation_count=20,minimum_logp=-12.,maximum_logp=0.,
        peak_process_rss_bytes=500000000,initial_counters=counters(0),final_counters=counters(seconds),
        telemetry_rows=seconds//interval,replays=4 if smoke else 13,decisions_per_elapsed_second=400.)
    rows=[dict(**counts(i),scheduled_seconds=i,elapsed_seconds=float(i),counters=counters(i),
        maximum_host_gap_seconds=.1,unexpected_compilations=0,minimum_logp=-12.,maximum_logp=0.,
        memory={'peak_process_rss_bytes':500000000}) for i in range(interval,seconds+1,interval)]
    r=dict(status='passed',mode='smoke' if smoke else 'qualification',two_hour_qualification=not smoke,
        final_reservation_unchanged=True,compile_control={'first_call_compilation_events':1,'same_shape_repeat_events':0},soak=s)
    for k in ('full_g2','full_g3','full_g4','public_ladder_strength','strength_evaluation','final_evaluation_used','public_server_used','prime_used'):r[k]=PLAN[k]
    return r,copy.deepcopy(PLAN),rows


class Gates(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_valid_modes(self):
        for smoke in (False,True):self.assertIsNone(gates.validate(*fixture(smoke)))

    def test_scope_and_target(self):
        for field,value in [('status','running'),('two_hour_qualification',False),('final_evaluation_used',True),('full_g3','closed')]:
            r,p,rows=fixture();r[field]=value
            with self.subTest(field=field),self.assertRaises(ValueError):gates.validate(r,p,rows)
        for key in ('qualification_seconds','seed','warmup_cycles','maximum_updates'):
            r,p,rows=fixture();p[key]=float(p[key])
            with self.subTest(key=key),self.assertRaises(ValueError):gates.validate(r,p,rows)
        r,p,rows=fixture();p['qualification_seconds']=10
        with self.assertRaises(ValueError):gates.validate(r,p,rows)

    def test_linkage_and_counts(self):
        for field in ('cycles','games','decisions','terminal','truncated'):
            r,p,rows=fixture();r['soak'][field]+=1
            with self.subTest(field=field),self.assertRaises(ValueError):gates.validate(r,p,rows)
        r,p,rows=fixture();r['soak']['final_counters']['next_game']+=32
        with self.assertRaises(ValueError):gates.validate(r,p,rows)

    def test_instability(self):
        for field,value in [('elapsed_seconds',7199.),('maximum_host_gap_seconds',31.),('minimum_logp',-34.),('maximum_logp',.01),('peak_process_rss_bytes',2**31+1),('unexpected_compilations',1),('replays',12)]:
            r,p,rows=fixture();r['soak'][field]=value
            with self.subTest(field=field),self.assertRaises(ValueError):gates.validate(r,p,rows)

    def test_telemetry_corruption(self):
        for change in ('missing','order','counters','actions','peak','negative'):
            r,p,rows=fixture()
            if change=='missing':rows.pop()
            if change=='order':rows[1]=copy.deepcopy(rows[0])
            if change=='counters':rows[1]['counters']['updates']+=1
            if change=='actions':rows[1]['actions'][0]+=1
            if change=='peak':rows[1]['memory']['peak_process_rss_bytes']=600000000
            if change=='negative':rows[1]['truncated']=-1
            with self.subTest(change=change),self.assertRaises(ValueError):gates.validate(r,p,rows)

    def test_malformed(self):
        for value in (None,[],{},True):
            r,p,rows=fixture()
            with self.subTest(value=value),self.assertRaises(ValueError):gates.validate(value,p,rows)
        for value in (True,float('nan'),float('inf'),'7200',None):
            r,p,rows=fixture();r['soak']['elapsed_seconds']=value
            with self.subTest(value=value),self.assertRaises(ValueError):gates.validate(r,p,rows)


if __name__=='__main__':unittest.main()
"""Pure switch soak gate (switch-soak-1).

Standard library only.  ``validate(report, plan, rows)`` returns ``None`` when
the report, frozen plan and telemetry rows are internally consistent and
raises ``ValueError`` for every other input (missing fields, wrong types,
booleans in numeric fields, NaN/inf, wrong scope, instability, broken counter
linkage, under-duration, mismatched telemetry).

This gate checks internal consistency only.  Source/runtime binding, report
checksums, telemetry hashes, checkpoint roster and fresh replay are owned by
the sealer.
"""

import math

__all__ = ["validate", "FROZEN_PLAN", "SCOPE_FIELDS"]

# --------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Frozen plan constants
# --------------------------------------------------------------------------

PLAN_VERSION = "switch-soak-1"

FROZEN_PLAN = {
    "qualification_seconds": 7200,
    "warmup_cycles": 8,
    "telemetry_seconds": 60,
    "checkpoint_seconds": 600,
    "maximum_host_gap_seconds": 30,
    "seed": 101,
    "maximum_updates": 10000000,
    "minimum_cycles": 1000,
    "maximum_peak_rss_bytes": 2147483648,
}

FROZEN_SMOKE = {
    "seconds": 20,
    "telemetry_seconds": 4,
    "checkpoint_seconds": 8,
}

SCOPE_FIELDS = (
    "full_g2",
    "full_g3",
    "full_g4",
    "public_ladder_strength",
    "strength_evaluation",
    "final_evaluation_used",
    "public_server_used",
    "prime_used",
)

FROZEN_SCOPE = {
    "full_g2": "open",
    "full_g3": "open",
    "full_g4": "open",
    "public_ladder_strength": "unqualified",
    "strength_evaluation": False,
    "final_evaluation_used": False,
    "public_server_used": False,
    "prime_used": False,
}

GAMES_PER_CYCLE = 32
MIN_DECISIONS_PER_CYCLE = 64
MAX_DECISIONS_PER_CYCLE = 896
OPTIMIZER_STEPS_PER_UPDATE = 2
GAMES_PER_UPDATE = 32
ACTION_COUNT = 4

LOGP_FLOOR = -48.0 * math.log(2.0) - 1e-5
LOGP_CEILING = 1e-6

COUNT_FIELDS = ("cycles", "games", "decisions", "terminal", "truncated")
COUNTER_FIELDS = ("updates", "optimizer_step", "next_game")


# --------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Primitive helpers
# --------------------------------------------------------------------------


def _fail(message):
    raise ValueError(message)


def _mapping(value, name):
    if not isinstance(value, dict):
        _fail("%s must be a mapping" % name)
    return value


def _get(mapping, key, name):
    if key not in mapping:
        _fail("%s missing field %r" % (name, key))
    return mapping[key]


def _is_int(value):
    return isinstance(value, int) and not isinstance(value, bool)


def _is_real(value):
    if isinstance(value, bool):
        return False
    if isinstance(value, int):
        return True
    if isinstance(value, float):
        return math.isfinite(value)
    return False


def _int(mapping, key, name, minimum=0):
    value = _get(mapping, key, name)
    if not _is_int(value):
        _fail("%s.%s must be an integer (not bool)" % (name, key))
    if value < minimum:
        _fail("%s.%s must be >= %r" % (name, key, minimum))
    return value


def _real(mapping, key, name):
    value = _get(mapping, key, name)
    if not _is_real(value):
        _fail("%s.%s must be a finite real number (not bool)" % (name, key))
    return value


def _bool(mapping, key, name):
    value = _get(mapping, key, name)
    if not isinstance(value, bool):
        _fail("%s.%s must be a boolean" % (name, key))
    return value


def _same(actual, expected):
    """Exact equality including type class (bool vs int vs str)."""
    if isinstance(expected, bool) or isinstance(actual, bool):
        return isinstance(actual, bool) and isinstance(expected, bool) and actual is expected
    if isinstance(expected, str) or isinstance(actual, str):
        return isinstance(actual, str) and isinstance(expected, str) and actual == expected
    if _is_real(expected):
        return _is_real(actual) and actual == expected
    return type(actual) is type(expected) and actual == expected


def _actions(mapping, name):
    value = _get(mapping, "actions", name)
    if not isinstance(value, list) or len(value) != ACTION_COUNT:
        _fail("%s.actions must be a list of four integer counts" % name)
    out = []
    for index, item in enumerate(value):
        if not _is_int(item) or item < 0:
            _fail("%s.actions[%d] must be a nonnegative integer" % (name, index))
        out.append(item)
    return out


# --------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Plan
# --------------------------------------------------------------------------


def _check_plan(plan):
    _mapping(plan, "plan")
    version = _get(plan, "version", "plan")
    if not isinstance(version, str) or version != PLAN_VERSION:
        _fail("plan.version must be %r" % PLAN_VERSION)
    for key, expected in FROZEN_PLAN.items():
        value = _get(plan, key, "plan")
        if not _is_real(value) or value != expected:
            _fail("plan.%s must be %r" % (key, expected))
    smoke = _mapping(_get(plan, "smoke", "plan"), "plan.smoke")
    for key, expected in FROZEN_SMOKE.items():
        value = _get(smoke, key, "plan.smoke")
        if not _is_real(value) or value != expected:
            _fail("plan.smoke.%s must be %r" % (key, expected))
    for key, expected in FROZEN_SCOPE.items():
        value = _get(plan, key, "plan")
        if not _same(value, expected):
            _fail("plan.%s must be %r" % (key, expected))


# --------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Accounting shared by summary and rows
# --------------------------------------------------------------------------


def _counts(mapping, name, minimum_cycles):
    counts = {}
    for key in COUNT_FIELDS:
        counts[key] = _int(mapping, key, name)
    counts["actions"] = _actions(mapping, name)
    cycles = counts["cycles"]
    if cycles < minimum_cycles:
        _fail("%s.cycles must be >= %d" % (name, minimum_cycles))
    if counts["games"] != GAMES_PER_CYCLE * cycles:
        _fail("%s.games must equal %d*cycles" % (name, GAMES_PER_CYCLE))
    decisions = counts["decisions"]
    if not (MIN_DECISIONS_PER_CYCLE * cycles <= decisions <= MAX_DECISIONS_PER_CYCLE * cycles):
        _fail("%s.decisions outside [%d, %d] per cycle" % (name, MIN_DECISIONS_PER_CYCLE, MAX_DECISIONS_PER_CYCLE))
    if counts["terminal"] + counts["truncated"] != counts["games"]:
        _fail("%s terminal+truncated must equal games" % name)
    if sum(counts["actions"]) != decisions:
        _fail("%s sum(actions) must equal decisions" % name)
    return counts


def _counters(mapping, key, name, maximum_updates):
    triple = _mapping(_get(mapping, key, name), "%s.%s" % (name, key))
    full = "%s.%s" % (name, key)
    out = {}
    for field in COUNTER_FIELDS:
        out[field] = _int(triple, field, full)
    updates = out["updates"]
    if updates > maximum_updates:
        _fail("%s.updates exceeds maximum updates" % full)
    if out["optimizer_step"] != OPTIMIZER_STEPS_PER_UPDATE * updates:
        _fail("%s.optimizer_step must equal %d*updates" % (full, OPTIMIZER_STEPS_PER_UPDATE))
    if out["next_game"] != GAMES_PER_UPDATE * updates:
        _fail("%s.next_game must equal %d*updates" % (full, GAMES_PER_UPDATE))
    return out


def _stability(mapping, name, peak_key_mapping, max_gap, rss_cap):
    gap = _real(mapping, "maximum_host_gap_seconds", name)
    if not (0 <= gap <= max_gap):
        _fail("%s.maximum_host_gap_seconds outside [0, %r]" % (name, max_gap))
    unexpected = _int(mapping, "unexpected_compilations", name)
    if unexpected != 0:
        _fail("%s.unexpected_compilations must be zero" % name)
    minimum_logp = _real(mapping, "minimum_logp", name)
    maximum_logp = _real(mapping, "maximum_logp", name)
    if not (LOGP_FLOOR <= minimum_logp <= maximum_logp <= LOGP_CEILING):
        _fail("%s log probabilities outside admissible range" % name)
    peak_name, peak_mapping = peak_key_mapping
    peak = _int(peak_mapping, "peak_process_rss_bytes", peak_name, minimum=1)
    if peak > rss_cap:
        _fail("%s.peak_process_rss_bytes exceeds cap" % peak_name)
    return peak


# --------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Report
# --------------------------------------------------------------------------


def _check_report_header(report, plan):
    _mapping(report, "report")
    status = _get(report, "status", "report")
    if not isinstance(status, str) or status != "passed":
        _fail("report.status must be 'passed'")
    mode = _get(report, "mode", "report")
    if not isinstance(mode, str) or mode not in ("qualification", "smoke"):
        _fail("report.mode must be 'qualification' or 'smoke'")
    smoke = mode == "smoke"
    two_hour = _bool(report, "two_hour_qualification", "report")
    if two_hour is smoke:
        _fail("report.two_hour_qualification must be true only for qualification")
    for key in SCOPE_FIELDS:
        value = _get(report, key, "report")
        if not _same(value, plan[key]):
            _fail("report.%s must preserve plan scope value %r" % (key, plan[key]))
    if _bool(report, "final_reservation_unchanged", "report") is not True:
        _fail("report.final_reservation_unchanged must be true")
    control = _mapping(_get(report, "compile_control", "report"), "report.compile_control")
    first = _real(control, "first_call_compilation_events", "report.compile_control")
    if not first > 0:
        _fail("report.compile_control.first_call_compilation_events must be positive")
    same_shape = _real(control, "same_shape_repeat_events", "report.compile_control")
    if same_shape != 0:
        _fail("report.compile_control.same_shape_repeat_events must be zero")
    return smoke


def _check_summary(soak, smoke):
    name = "report.soak"
    _mapping(soak, name)
    if smoke:
        target = FROZEN_SMOKE["seconds"]
        interval = FROZEN_SMOKE["telemetry_seconds"]
        checkpoint = FROZEN_SMOKE["checkpoint_seconds"]
        minimum_cycles = 1
    else:
        target = FROZEN_PLAN["qualification_seconds"]
        interval = FROZEN_PLAN["telemetry_seconds"]
        checkpoint = FROZEN_PLAN["checkpoint_seconds"]
        minimum_cycles = FROZEN_PLAN["minimum_cycles"]
    max_gap = FROZEN_PLAN["maximum_host_gap_seconds"]
    rss_cap = FROZEN_PLAN["maximum_peak_rss_bytes"]
    warmup = FROZEN_PLAN["warmup_cycles"]
    maximum_updates = FROZEN_PLAN["maximum_updates"]

    elapsed = _real(soak, "elapsed_seconds", name)
    if not (target <= elapsed <= target + max_gap):
        _fail("%s.elapsed_seconds outside [%d, %d]" % (name, target, target + max_gap))
    cpu = _real(soak, "process_cpu_seconds", name)
    if not cpu > 0:
        _fail("%s.process_cpu_seconds must be positive" % name)
    cycle_seconds = _real(soak, "cycle_seconds", name)
{
